name: OpenAnimalNutrition
title: Open Animal Nutrition — Adequacy Interoperability Guide
description: A FHIR Implementation Guide for representing and verifying the nutritional adequacy of an animal diet against published requirement standards (NRC, AAFCO, FEDIAF), expressed on a common mathematical basis. Species-agnostic by design; v0.1 binds canine and feline coverage. This guide models the adequacy VERDICT, not the means of producing a passing diet.
